title: Congress's push to check identity and risk before federal money goes out
adds: Over 17 months the House Oversight Committee built a case for screening people, accounts and payments before Treasury pays. The July 15, 2026 hearing pushed that toward constant identity monitoring, but none of it is law: the key bills passed only the House.
